我的生活与健康生活(My Life and a healthy life): 一篇关于健康生活的A2短文:艾米与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。

Amy plays volleyball with Grace every Saturday. There are always many people at the school clinic. The running track is one of the best places in the city. For example, the dog buried a bone in the garden.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the running track by bike. The weather was snowy that day. Life is full of small surprises. Best of all, the dog ran away from home.
Last Saturday, Amy and Grace went to the running track. Grace's birthday is in December. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. For example, the doctor listened to his chest.
Amy usually has chicken for breakfast. They took many photos at the school clinic. Amy hopes to visit Sydney one day.
